counting_rule: Summary uses the final result for each unique case. Historical failed attempts remain in their original artifacts. Artifact counts overlap; capture, Core77 control, Store and Pi host cohorts remain separately counted.
privacy_policy: This index contains only allowlisted paths, file hashes, counts, states and source attribution. Raw log bodies, connection strings, environment files, credentials and user/account data are not copied.

core_local_candidate.execution_basis: Frozen local candidate input manifests before publication; use each execution receipt and input manifest for exact bytes, rather than assuming every earlier attempt ran on a clean published commit.

core_compile_diagnostic.execution_basis: Compilation failed before case execution; production_behavior_changed=false.

core_setup_only.execution_basis: Setup assertions stopped before cargo; no case or product code execution is claimed.

core_final_candidate.scope: Strengthens successful SSE terminal-event assertions; production behavior, timeouts and expected settlement 49 remain unchanged. Exact final recheck passed 1/1; original failure remains and its cause is not uniquely confirmed.

core77_control.causal_limit: One passing control run does not independently prove the cause of the component78 failure.

store_main_candidate.execution_basis: Main worktree with the five-file change; published afterward as mapped commit.

toolmarket_b5ee.execution_basis: Reuse two original Toolmarket PostgreSQL cases; the third original MerchantHome result is not the current main-line MerchantHome proof.

core_ordinary.qualification_note: The earlier Pi runtime failure is retained. A passing exact recheck does not uniquely identify the cause or establish permanent elimination.

artifacts.scope_limit: WALWrite and WalSync waits were observed. No request lock blocking/lock timeout was captured in this run; this is not an assertion of no waiting or a uniquely established fix.

artifacts.hash_scope: Exact bytes read at index generation before cleanup; this is a retained prefix snapshot if the live log later grows. Do not treat this hash as the post-cleanup full-file hash.

final_observation.scope_limit: One passing run with no captured request lock blocking or lock timeout; not absence of all waits.
